cohort: 1903 individuals who had abortions at an urban clinic in San Francisco, CA, from 2015 to 2017
finding: Homelessness or housing instability was associated with later presentation for abortion and an increased frequency of abortion complications, and this relationship was mediated by gestational age at presentation.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at presentation 13.3 weeks in those experiencing homelessness or housing instability vs 9.5 weeks in those with stable housing
